attchmntText: Hindcon Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about related Party Transactions for half year ended on 30.09.2020.
Hindcon Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication published on 13.11.2020 for approval of Un-audited Financial Results for the Half Year ended 30.09.2020.

Hindcon Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on November 12, 2020 to approve the Standalone and Consolidated Un-audited Financial Results of the Company for the half year ended on September 30, 2020 and the same is attached alongwith Statement of Assets & Liabilities, Cash Flow Statement for the half year ended on 30" September, 2020 along with Limited Review Report.
Hindcon Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 under Reg 74(5).

attchmntText: Hindcon Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 from 1st October, 2020 till 48 hours after the declaration of financial results to the Stock Exchanges for the quarter and half year ending on 31st September, 2020.

Hindcon Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 under Reg 74(5) for the quarter ended 31st March, 2021.

Re-appointment of Mr. Girdhari Lal Goenka (DIN: 00613725) as an Independent Director of the Company for a further period of 5 (five) years w.e-f. 8th August, 2022;3.
